name: Repository Git read-only MCP
summary: Expose bounded local Git status, diff, and history inspection through a pinned MCP server.
description: Installs a local stdio MCP server that runs only fixed read-only Git status, diff, and log forms in the current repository, strips Git environment overrides, and never contacts a remote.
refuses: It does not commit, stage, restore, reset, switch, merge, fetch, push, or mutate repository state.
It does not accept arbitrary Git flags, revisions, subprocesses, aliases, configuration, or environment overrides.
It does not contact remotes, read credentials, or claim that inspected history is authentic or trusted.

entrypoints.purpose: Serve three fixed bounded read-only Git inspection tools over local standard input and output.

mcpServer.trustBoundary: Only bounded output from fixed local Git status, diff, and log invocations crosses the server boundary; Git environment overrides and remote operations are excluded.
